question: What percentage of all trains have at least 4 cars? Also list the distinct directions of those trains.
gold_sql: WITH train_lengths AS (SELECT t.id, t.direction, MAX(c.position) AS car_count FROM trains AS t JOIN cars AS c ON t.id = c.train_id GROUP BY t.id, t.direction), pct AS (SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN car_count >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM train_lengths) SELECT pct.percentage, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tl.direction) AS directions FROM pct CROSS JOIN train_lengths AS tl WHERE tl.car_count >= 4 GROUP BY pct.percentage
evidence: at least 4 cars refers to trailPosi > = 4; calculation = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(count(trailPosi > = 4 then id), count(id)), 100)
correction_category: Gold SQL 输出结构错误
correction_reason: 原 Gold 用 UNION ALL 把百分比和方向混在同一列，并重复列出每辆符合条件 train 的方向，输出结构不适合评估。修复版明确为一行返回百分比和符合条件 trains 的 distinct directions。
original_question: What is the percentage of all the trains with at least 4 cars? List the directions of the said trains.
original_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.trailPosi >= 4 THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM trains AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT train_id, MAX(position) AS trailPosi FROM cars GROUP BY train_id ) AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.train_id UNION ALL SELECT T1.direction FROM trains AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT train_id, MAX(position) AS trailPosi FROM cars t GROUP BY train_id ) AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.train_id AND T2.trailPosi >= 4

question: List each train's head-car load shape, identify the most common head-car load shape, and calculate the percentage of trains with that most common head-car load shape that run east.
gold_sql: WITH head_cars AS (SELECT c.train_id, c.load_shape, t.direction FROM cars AS c JOIN trains AS t ON c.train_id = t.id WHERE c.position = 1), shape_counts AS (SELECT load_shape, COUNT(*) AS shape_count FROM head_cars GROUP BY load_shape), most_common AS (SELECT load_shape FROM shape_counts ORDER BY shape_count DESC, load_shape ASC LIMIT 1), east_stats AS (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'east' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_east FROM head_cars WHERE load_shape = (SELECT load_shape FROM most_common)) SELECT train_id, load_shape AS head_car_load_shape, (SELECT load_shape FROM most_common) AS most_common_load_shape, (SELECT percentage_east FROM east_stats) AS percentage_east FROM head_cars ORDER BY train_id
evidence: which load shape has the highest number refers to MAX(load_shape); head car refers to position = 1; east is a direction; calculation = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(count(direction = 'east' where MAX(load_shape) where position = 1 then id), count(id)), 100)
correction_category: 评测标准有问题 / 题目复杂但预测更合理
correction_reason: 题目要求列出每列 train 的 head car load shape，找出现次数最多的 load shape，并计算该 shape 中 east trains 的百分比。原 Gold 用 train_id DESC LIMIT 1 选所谓最高数量，明显不符合 highest number；修复版按 head car load_shape 聚合。
original_question: List all the load shapes of all head cars of each train and identify which load shape has the highest number. Calculate the percentage of the trains with the said head car that are running eas
original_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.load_shape FROM ( SELECT load_shape, train_id FROM cars WHERE position = 1 ORDER BY train_id DESC ) AS T3 UNION ALL SELECT T4.load_shape FROM ( SELECT load_shape, train_id FROM cars WHERE position = 1 ORDER BY train_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T4 UNION ALL SELECT (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.direction = 'east' THEN T2.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.id)) FROM cars AS T1 INNER JOIN trains AS T2 ON T1.train_id = T2.id WHERE T1.position = 1 AND T1.load_shape = ( SELECT T4.load_shape FROM ( SELECT load_shape, train_id FROM cars AS T WHERE position = 1 ORDER BY train_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T4 )
